prompt:
[GENERATION GOAL]
30-second cinematic fashion-travel music video following one beautiful sweet slim young woman across New Zealand — starting on a rainy Auckland street, moving through a coastal train journey, green countryside and finally a dramatic black-sand beach where she dances with a friend. She listens to music through white wired earphones and carries a Sony compact camera. Photoreal live-action, energetic editorial pacing, hard cuts only.

[CORE LOOK]
Premium outdoor fashion commercial meets cinematic road-trip film.
Cool blue rain, emerald greens, volcanic black sand, warm sunset skin tones.
Natural film grain, subtle lens bloom, realistic moisture and atmospheric perspective.
24fps, 180-degree shutter.
No artificial CGI look, no beauty smoothing, no warped faces, no duplicated people, no random text, no watermarks.

[LEAD]
Generate a new original beautiful sweet slim woman in her early 20s.
Heart-shaped face, bright hazel-brown eyes, long dark wavy hair, soft straight brows, subtle brown eyeliner, naturally glossy peach lips, fair warm skin with realistic freckles across nose and cheeks, slim athletic figure, delicate hands, short glossy pale-pink nails.
She has an innocent sweet smile and playful personality.
No glasses.
She never speaks.

White wired earphones in both ears whenever she appears. Cable remains visible.

[FRIEND]
Appears from 22s onward.
Young East-Asian woman, early 20s, short dark bob haircut, oversized pale-yellow sweatshirt, loose denim trousers, white sneakers.
No earphones.

[FASHION / PRODUCT]
LOOK A 0–6.5s:
Royal-blue Nike windbreaker, black straight-leg pants, white sneakers, small black shoulder bag. Sony RX100-style compact camera in hand.

LOOK B 6.5–15.5s:
Cream Nike cropped fleece jacket, forest-green cargo skirt over black leggings, silver watch, cream mini backpack.

LOOK C 15.5–30s:
Graphite Nike lightweight track jacket, loose black trousers, white sneakers, small silver hoop earrings.

No Adidas. No Puma. Nike branding stays physically correct and understated.

[LOCATIONS]
LOC 1 — Auckland rainy street:
Glass towers, wet pavement, neon reflections, green trees, moving pedestrians and buses.

LOC 2 — Historic railway platform:
Dark green station canopy, old benches, rain droplets, passengers waiting naturally.

LOC 3 — Coastal train:
Large window, ocean cliffs outside, woman seated beside window.

LOC 4 — Train reflection:
Close-up of her face reflected in rain-covered glass, city disappearing behind.

LOC 5 — Countryside station:
Wooden platform, green hills, sheep pasture in distance.

LOC 6 — Mountain road:
Long winding road through emerald hills.

LOC 7 — Waterfall trail:
Wet wooden walkway, huge waterfall behind mist.

LOC 8 — Black-sand beach:
Wide volcanic beach, dark rocks, crashing turquoise-grey ocean.

LOC 9 — Cliff path:
Grass-covered cliff edge, strong ocean wind.

LOC 10 — Beach café:
Small wooden café, surfboards, warm interior lights.

LOC 11 — Coastal overlook:
Two wooden benches facing ocean.

LOC 12 — Final beach plaza:
Open black-sand area with distant cliffs and sea.

[30-SECOND TIMELINE]

0.0–2.2s
SHOT 1 — RAIN OPEN
50mm handheld close-up. Woman walks beneath light rain in LOOK A. Drops collect on blue jacket. She smiles while listening to music.

2.2–3.8s
SHOT 2 — CAMERA DETAIL
85mm ECU. Her fingers switch Sony camera mode. White earphone cable crosses jacket naturally.

3.8–6.5s
SHOT 3 — STREET CROSS
35mm tracking shot. She crosses wet street, turns toward camera with a small smile. Bus passes behind, creating natural foreground wipe.

6.5–8.6s
SHOT 4 — PLATFORM CUT
Hard cut on bus wipe. LOOK B. She walks onto railway platform holding camera and cream backpack.

8.6–10.4s
SHOT 5 — TRAIN ARRIVAL
24mm. Train enters frame, wind moves her hair and fleece. She looks toward it.

10.4–12.6s
SHOT 6 — WINDOW
50mm inside train. She sits beside window, earphones visible, cheek against glass, watching countryside.

12.6–14.2s
SHOT 7 — REFLECTION
85mm close. Her face reflected in rain-streaked window. She closes eyes for a second and smiles.

14.2–16.0s
SHOT 8 — TITLE
Hard cut to countryside station.
She steps down from train.
Huge yellow condensed text:
【NEW ZEALAND】
appears vertically beside her as she walks forward.

16.0–18.0s
SHOT 9 — GREEN HILLS
24mm wide. LOOK C begins. She walks through a grassy mountain road, camera tracking sideways. Clouds move across distant hills.

18.0–19.8s
SHOT 10 — WATERFALL
Wide 24mm. She stands near wet wooden trail, turns toward massive waterfall and laughs.

19.8–21.6s
SHOT 11 — OCEAN REVEAL
Hard cut. She walks over grassy cliff path. Camera starts behind her and gently moves beside her, revealing black-sand beach below.

21.6–23.2s
SHOT 12 — FRIEND ARRIVAL
Friend enters from frame right holding two takeaway drinks. Lead turns and laughs.

23.2–25.0s
SHOT 13 — BEACH WALK
35mm two-shot. Both walk barefoot along black sand, shoes in hands, laughing naturally. Wind moves their clothes.

25.0–26.4s
SHOT 14 — CAMERA SNAP
85mm. Friend takes Sony camera from lead and quickly photographs her. Lead laughs and covers face playfully.

26.4–28.0s
SHOT 15 — RUN TO WATER
Wide 24mm. Both run toward shallow waves, jackets and hair moving naturally.

28.0–30.0s
SHOT 16 — DANCE + TITLE
Wide-to-medium. They stop near beach café and dance freely to music, no choreography.
At 28.6s bold yellow condensed text hits:
【KEEP MOVING】
Then at 29.3s:
【KEEP DREAMING】
Both stacked over the dancing pair.
Lead throws one arm upward and laughs.
Hard cut to black.

[CAMERA / MOVEMENT]
Rain shots: handheld 50mm.
Train: locked and intimate 50–85mm.
Landscape: 24mm with natural atmospheric depth.
Beach: low 24mm and gentle lateral tracking.
No drone orbit.
No crash zoom.
No artificial slow motion.
Hard cuts motivated by movement.

[PHYSICS]
Rain beads remain physically attached to fabric.
Wet pavement reflects real light.
Hair reacts to wind and moisture.
Earphone cable never vanishes.
Camera has realistic weight.
Fleece and nylon wrinkle naturally.
Ocean spray moves independently.
Footsteps disturb wet sand realistically.

[LIGHTING]
Auckland: cool cloudy daylight and practical city reflections.
Train: soft window light.
Countryside: diffused cloud light.
Waterfall: cool mist bounce.
Beach: overcast coastal light transitioning into warm late-day glow.
Faces retain realistic skin texture and eye catchlights.

[AUDIO]
Rain hitting jacket.
Street traffic.
Train brakes and rail vibration.
Camera shutter.
Distant waterfall.
Ocean wind.
Footsteps on wet sand.
Small natural laughs.
No dialogue.
No voiceover.
No lyrics.
Only two specified English title cards.

[FINAL CONSISTENCY]
One original lead throughout.
Friend only from 21.6s.
White wired earphones remain visible.
Nike is the only fashion-sports brand.
Sony compact camera remains consistent.
Photoreal premium live-action.
No anime, no 3D, no plastic skin.

A simple rainy-day bakery vlog, captured like a real smartphone moment ☕️🥐

Made with Seedance 2.5 on @wavespeed_ai 

Prompt - MODE / OUTPUT: Seedance 2.5 all-in-one reference, 30 seconds, 4:3, 720P, 1 result, audio ON, NO MUSIC. A 15-shot Vlog montage recorded directly on a smartphone, with each shot lasting exactly 2 seconds. Every time boundary is an immediate hard cut.

REFERENCE / CHARACTERS: {{image 1}} defines only Lizzy’s face, hair, body type, and identity. {{Image 2}} defines only Lee Han’s face, hair, body type, and identity. Lizzy and Lee Han are the two protagonists. One adult guardian is present only as a small background character. Do not transfer any other people, backgrounds, poses, text, clothing, logos, or visual elements from either reference.

CAMERA: Every frame is original footage recorded directly with the same smartphone operated by Lee Han using his right hand. The viewer perspective matches the phone lens position. No external camera filming Lee Han.

During rear-camera footage, Lizzy and the environment are visible while Lee Han exists only through his off-screen voice and small portions of his left hand or arm. During front-facing selfie footage, Lizzy and Lee Han can both appear. The guardian may appear small in the background.

The smartphone and Lee Han’s right hand holding it must never appear in the frame or reflections. Fixed 1.0x lens, no zoom. Only short handheld walking follow shots and stationary selfie shots. No cinematic camera movement. Preserve natural hand shake, imperfect framing, slight focus delay, and authentic smartphone exposure.

LOOK / SETTING: A warm late-afternoon residential street just after light summer rain. Wet pavement, small neighborhood bakery, soft reflections on the road, green trees, cloudy golden daylight breaking through the clouds. Natural everyday atmosphere, subtle bloom.

SEQUENCE:

- 0–2 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy walks beside the small neighborhood bakery and suddenly notices a tiny handwritten-looking bakery display through the window. She slows down and points toward it with her right hand.

- 2–4 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy looks toward Lee Han outside the right side of the frame and says, “Wait, look at that.” Lee Han responds off-screen, “What?”

- 4–6 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy steps closer to the bakery window and looks at a small tray of freshly baked pastries. She smiles and quietly says, “They look so good.”

- 6–8 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy turns toward the entrance. Lee Han’s left hand briefly enters the frame and gestures toward the door while he says off-screen, “Let’s check.”

- 8–10 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy opens the bakery door and holds it for Lee Han. A warm interior glow briefly spills onto the wet sidewalk.

- 10–12 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy stands near the counter and points at one pastry while asking the guardian, “Can we get this one?” The guardian smiles and nods from farther behind.

- 12–14 sec — Rear-camera original footage. Lizzy receives the small paper bag and carefully holds it with both hands. She looks toward Lee Han and laughs.

- 14–16 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage, no dialogue. Lee Han crouches slightly beside Lizzy outside the bakery. Lizzy lifts the paper bag toward the camera with a proud smile.

- 16–18 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage. Lizzy opens the bag slightly and says, “You get the first bite.” Lee Han looks at her and says, “Really?”

- 18–20 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage, no dialogue. Lizzy breaks off a small piece and holds it toward Lee Han. He leans slightly forward and takes it from her hand.

- 20–22 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage. Lee Han reacts with a surprised smile and says, “Okay, this is really good.” Lizzy laughs beside him.

- 22–24 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage. Lizzy takes a small bite herself, looks at Lee Han, and says, “I told you.”

- 24–26 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage, no dialogue. They both look down at the remaining pastry. Lizzy holds the bag between them while Lee Han gently steadies the bottom of the bag with his left hand.

- 26–28 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage, no dialogue. Their hands briefly touch around the paper bag. They look at each other and smile naturally.

- 28–30 sec — Front-facing selfie original footage, no dialogue. They start walking away from the bakery together. Lizzy keeps the paper bag close while Lee Han turns the phone slightly toward the wet street. Natural walking shake continues until the final frame.

AUDIO / FIXED: Natural Seoul high-school-student speech, quiet neighborhood ambience, faint footsteps on wet pavement, subtle bakery door sounds, and natural clothing movement only. NO MUSIC, no added sound effects, no subtitles, no captions.

Maintain exact continuity of Lizzy, Lee Han, bakery bag, hands, environment, and clothing. No duplicated people or objects. No external observer shot at any point. Final frame must still be original smartphone footage from the same lens.

translations.zh:
【生成目标】
30秒电影级时尚旅行音乐短片，跟随一位甜美苗条的年轻女子游历新西兰——从雨中的奥克兰街头启程，途经沿海火车之旅、绿色乡村，最终到达壮丽的黑沙滩并与朋友共舞。她戴着白色有线耳机听音乐，随身携带索尼便携相机。逼真真人实拍风格，充满活力的剪辑节奏，仅使用硬切转场。

【核心视觉风格】
高端户外时尚广告与公路旅行电影的结合。冷蓝色雨景、翠绿色、火山黑沙、温暖的夕阳肤色。自然胶片颗粒、微妙的镜头光晕、逼真的水汽与空气透视感。24fps，180度快门。无人工CGI感、无美颜磨皮、无面部扭曲、无人物重影、无随机文字与水印。

【主角设定】
全新原创的20岁出头甜美苗条女性。心形脸、明亮的淡褐眼、黑色长微卷发、柔和直眉、微细棕色眼线、自然光泽的蜜桃唇、白皙温暖带雀斑的皮肤、苗条健美身形、精致双手。天真甜美笑容与俏皮性格。不戴眼镜，全程不说话。出现时双耳佩戴白色有线耳机且线缆清晰可见。

【朋友设定】
22秒起出现。20岁出头东亚年轻女性，黑色短波浪头，宽松浅黄套头卫衣、宽松牛仔裤、白球鞋。不戴耳机。

【时尚与产品】
造型A（0–6.5s）：宝蓝色耐克风衣，黑色直筒裤，白球鞋，黑色小单肩包，手持索尼RX100风格便携相机。
造型B（6.5–15.5s）：米色耐克短款摇粒绒夹克，森林绿工装裙配黑色打底裤，银色手表，米色迷你双肩包。
造型C（15.5–30s）：石墨色耐克轻薄运动夹克，宽松黑裤，白球鞋，银色小耳圈。
无阿迪达斯与彪马标志，耐克标志保持真实低调。

【各场景及30秒分镜时间线】
详述从奥克兰雨街、历史车站、沿海火车、乡村车站、翠绿山路、瀑布步道到黑沙滩漫步、拍照及最终海滩咖啡馆前随性跳舞的全程分镜、机位参数、物理光影与环境音效指令。
translations.en:
[GENERATION GOAL]
30-second cinematic fashion-travel music video following one beautiful sweet slim young woman across New Zealand — starting on a rainy Auckland street, moving through a coastal train journey, green countryside and finally a dramatic black-sand beach where she dances with a friend. She listens to music through white wired earphones and carries a Sony compact camera. Photoreal live-action, energetic editorial pacing, hard cuts only.

[CORE LOOK]
Premium outdoor fashion commercial meets cinematic road-trip film.
Cool blue rain, emerald greens, volcanic black sand, warm sunset skin tones.
Natural film grain, subtle lens bloom, realistic moisture and atmospheric perspective.
24fps, 180-degree shutter.
No artificial CGI look, no beauty smoothing, no warped faces, no duplicated people, no random text, no watermarks.

[LEAD]
Generate a new original beautiful sweet slim woman in her early 20s.

She has an innocent sweet smile and playful personality.
No glasses.
She never speaks.

White wired earphones in both ears whenever she appears. Cable remains visible.
